comment: Shared config fixtures for the plugin (test/unit) and the deploy tool (tools/deploy/tests).
Each case patches 'base' (set or delete at a /-separated path) and states the expected verdicts:
'schema' is the JSON Schema verdict (valid/invalid); 'verdict' is what both the plugin (parse and EDS checks)
and the deploy tool's checks must decide (accept/reject). 'messages' must appear in both outputs,
'plugin_messages' / 'tool_messages' only in one. 'warnings' must appear in the plugin's and the tool's warnings.
EDS paths are relative to test/fixtures/eds/, where the config is treated as living.

cases.name: schema_version from the future
messages: schema_version 3 is not supported; the highest supported version is 2

cases.name: adapter and top-level interface
messages: give either 'adapter' or the deprecated top-level 'interface', not both

cases.name: no adapter
messages: missing required field 'adapter'

cases.name: unknown adapter type
messages: adapter type "pcan" is not supported (supported: socketcan, slcan)

cases.name: slcan adapter without device
plugin_messages: adapter: missing required field 'device'
tool_messages: adapter: the serial device is missing

cases.name: slcan device not an absolute path
messages: adapter: field 'device' must be an absolute path such as /dev/ttyACM0

cases.name: slcan adapter with configure_link
messages: adapter: field 'configure_link' does not apply to adapter type slcan

cases.name: socketcan adapter with a serial device
messages: adapter: field 'device' does not apply to adapter type socketcan

cases.name: slcan serial speed zero
plugin_messages: field 'serial_baudrate' must be 1 or higher

cases.name: node ID out of range
plugin_messages: node ID 200 is out of range (1-127)

cases.name: node ID of the wrong type
plugin_messages: field 'node_id' is not a valid integer

cases.name: no sync period, synchronous EDS transmission types
messages: node 2 (pingpong): TPDO 1: transmission type 1 (from the EDS) needs SYNC, but the master produces none; set master.sync_period_us, "sync_source": "plc_cycle" or "transmission": 254 or 255
node 2 (pingpong): RPDO 1: transmission type 1 (from the EDS) needs SYNC

cases.name: no sync period, synchronous transmission in the config
messages: node 2 (pingpong) TPDO 1: transmission type 1 needs SYNC, but the master produces none

cases.name: no sync period, sync window
messages: field 'sync_window_us' needs 'sync_period_us' or "sync_source": "plc_cycle" (without them the master produces no SYNC)

cases.name: no sync period, sync counter
messages: field 'sync_counter_overflow' needs 'sync_period_us'

cases.name: no sync period, sync start
messages: node 2 (pingpong) TPDO 1: field 'sync_start' needs 'sync_period_us'

cases.name: plc cycle sync, synchronous EDS transmission types
plc cycle sync every 4 cycles, window and counter
plc cycle sync with a sync period
messages: field 'sync_period_us' cannot be used with "sync_source": "plc_cycle": the SYNC period comes from the PLC cycle

cases.name: sync cycles without plc cycle sync
messages: field 'sync_cycles' needs "sync_source": "plc_cycle"

cases.name: unknown sync source
plugin_messages: field 'sync_source' must be "timer" or "plc_cycle"

cases.name: sync cycles out of range
plugin_messages: field 'sync_cycles' must be 1-1000

cases.name: bit rate not CiA 301
plugin_messages: field 'bitrate' must be a CiA 301 bit rate

cases.name: unsupported type name
plugin_messages: unsupported type "UINT32"

cases.name: tx entry with an output location
plugin_messages: needs an input location

cases.name: node state byte not an input byte
plugin_messages: state_location must be an input byte

cases.name: EMCY code not an input word
plugin_messages: emcy_code_location must be an input word

cases.name: error register not an input byte
plugin_messages: error_register_location must be an input byte

cases.name: bus state not an input byte
plugin_messages: bus_state_location must be an input byte

cases.name: error counter an output
plugin_messages: tx_error_count_location must be an input byte

cases.name: bus-off count not an input word
plugin_messages: bus_off_count_location must be an input word

cases.name: tx_pdos entry on a receive-only object

cases.name: startup SDO on a read-only object
messages: node 2, index 0x1000, subindex 0: startup SDO needs a writable object (AccessType wo, rw, rwr or rww), but its AccessType is ro

cases.name: startup SDO data type mismatch
messages: node 2, index 0x1017, subindex 0: configured type UNSIGNED32 does not match the EDS data type UNSIGNED16

cases.name: object not PDO-mappable
messages: node 2, index 0x1000, subindex 0: object is not PDO-mappable in cpp-slave.eds

cases.name: object not in the EDS
messages: node 2, index 0x4005, subindex 0: object is not defined in cpp-slave.eds

cases.name: startup SDO object not in the EDS
messages: node 2, index 0x2000, subindex 0: object is not defined in cpp-slave.eds

cases.name: PDO number not on the slave
messages: node 2 (pingpong): TPDO 2 does not exist in cpp-slave.eds (no object 0x1801/0x1A01)

cases.name: type does not fit the location
messages: node 2 (pingpong), object 0x4001:0: type UNSIGNED32 (32 bit) does not fit location %IW100 (16 bit)

cases.name: node ID used twice
messages: node ID 2 is used by more than one slave

cases.name: node ID of the master
messages: node ID 1 is the master's node ID

cases.name: TPDO inhibit time and SYNC start value
inhibit time not a multiple of 100 us
messages: TPDO 1: field 'inhibit_time_us' must be a multiple of 100

cases.name: inhibit time on an RPDO
messages: RPDO 1: field 'inhibit_time_us' is only for tx_pdos (PDOs the node sends)

cases.name: SYNC start value on an RPDO
messages: RPDO 1: field 'sync_start' is only for tx_pdos (PDOs the node sends)

cases.name: SYNC start value with an event-driven TPDO
messages: TPDO 1: field 'sync_start' needs a synchronous transmission type (1-240), not 255

cases.name: RPDO event timer without the sub-index in the EDS
messages: node 2 (pingpong): RPDO 1: 'event_timer_ms' needs object 0x1400 subindex 5, which cpp-slave.eds does not define

cases.name: read-only RPDO transmission type
messages: node 2 (pingpong): RPDO 1: 'transmission' needs object 0x1400 subindex 2, but its AccessType in pdo-comm.eds is ro (EDS value 255); leave the field out or set it to the EDS value

cases.name: read-only RPDO transmission type set to the EDS value
read-only TPDO inhibit time
messages: node 2 (pingpong): TPDO 1: 'inhibit_time_us' needs object 0x1800 subindex 3, but its AccessType in pdo-comm.eds is ro (EDS value 0); leave the field out or set it to the EDS value

cases.name: startup SDO overrides heartbeat_ms
warnings: node 2 (pingpong): startup SDO to 0x1017 subindex 0 runs last and overrides heartbeat_ms

cases.name: startup SDO overrides the PDO settings
warnings: node 2 (pingpong): startup SDO to 0x1800 subindex 2 runs last and overrides the PDO settings (the plugin sets up every PDO of the node)

cases.name: master start false
warnings: master: 'start' is false: the master stays PRE-OPERATIONAL and no PDOs are exchanged until it is started

cases.name: boot SDO timeout maximum as a string
boot SDO timeout too short
plugin_messages: master: field 'sdo_timeout_ms' must be 10-60000: 5

cases.name: boot SDO timeout string too long
plugin_messages: master: field 'sdo_timeout_ms' must be 10-60000: 60001
tool_messages: master.sdo_timeout_ms: SDO timeout must be 10 to 60000

cases.name: TIME producer without a consumer
warnings: the master produces TIME, but no configured node is set to consume it

cases.name: TIME producer with a consuming node
TIME period too short
plugin_messages: master: field 'time_period_ms' must be 100-3600000: 10

cases.name: TIME period string too long
plugin_messages: master: field 'time_period_ms' must be 100-3600000: 3600001
tool_messages: master.time_period_ms: TIME period must be 100 to 3600000

cases.name: NMT inhibit time not a multiple of 100 us
plugin_messages: master: field 'nmt_inhibit_time_us' must be a multiple of 100: 150

cases.name: EMCY inhibit time string not a multiple of 100 us
plugin_messages: master: field 'emcy_inhibit_time_us' must be a multiple of 100: 150
tool_messages: master.emcy_inhibit_time_us: EMCY inhibit time must be a multiple of 100

cases.name: SYNC counter overflow 1
plugin_messages: field 'sync_counter_overflow' must be 0 (no counter) or 2-240

cases.name: error behavior sub-index 0
messages: master: error_behavior: sub-index "0" must be 1-254

cases.name: master state byte not an input byte
plugin_messages: state_location must be an input byte

cases.name: boot error byte not an input byte
plugin_messages: boot_error_location must be an input byte

cases.name: node heartbeat consumer without a master heartbeat
messages: nodes[0]: 'heartbeat_consumer' needs a master heartbeat (master 'heartbeat_ms' above 0)

cases.name: software version without a file
messages: node 2 (pingpong): 'software_version' needs 'software_file'

cases.name: configuration check without 0x1020 in the EDS
messages: node 2, index 0x1020, subindex 1: config_check needs this object, but it is not defined in cpp-slave.eds
node 2, index 0x1020, subindex 2: config_check needs this object, but it is not defined in cpp-slave.eds

cases.name: configuration check with a read-only 0x1020
messages: node 2, index 0x1020, subindex 1: config_check needs a writable object (AccessType wo, rw, rwr or rww), but its AccessType is ro

cases.name: save to a 0x1010 sub-index the EDS lacks
messages: node 2, index 0x1010, subindex 3: store_configuration needs this object, but it is not defined in config-check-ro.eds

cases.name: save without a configuration check
messages: node 2 (pingpong): 'store_configuration' needs 'config_check', so the node saves only after a download

cases.name: save sub-index out of range
plugin_messages: node 2 (pingpong): field 'store_configuration' must be a 0x1010 sub-index 1-127: 128

cases.name: software file missing
messages: node 2 (pingpong): software_file "fw/missing.bin" not found

cases.name: software file without a version
warnings: node 2 (pingpong): 'software_file' without 'software_version': the master never downloads it

cases.name: startup SDO overrides error_behavior
warnings: node 2 (pingpong): startup SDO to 0x1029 subindex 1 runs last and overrides error_behavior

cases.name: SDO variables and an NMT command byte
SDO variable write entry on an input location
plugin_messages: node 2 (pingpong), SDO variable 0x4000:0: a write entry needs an output location (%Q...), not %ID200

cases.name: SDO variable type does not fit its location
messages: node 2 (pingpong), SDO variable 0x1018:1 (vendor): type UNSIGNED32 (32 bit) does not fit location %IW200 (16 bit)

cases.name: SDO variable period on a write entry
plugin_messages: node 2 (pingpong), SDO variable 0x4000:0: field 'period_ms' is only for read entries

cases.name: SDO variable writes a read-only object
messages: node 2, index 0x1018, subindex 1: SDO variable to write needs a writable object (AccessType wo, rw, rwr or rww), but its AccessType is ro

cases.name: SDO variable writes the heartbeat period

cases.name: NMT command byte of the wrong size

cases.name: fixed PDO mapping used as the device has it
warnings: node 2 (pingpong): RPDO 1 uses the device mapping; objects not in 'entries' are sent as 0: 0x6200:2

cases.name: mapping config on a fixed PDO
messages: node 2 (pingpong): TPDO 1: 'mapping' is "config", but fixed-io.eds fixes the mapping (0x1A00 subindex 0 is ro); leave 'mapping' out or set it to "device"

cases.name: entry outside the device mapping
messages: node 2, index 0x6000, subindex 3: not in the default mapping of TPDO 1 in fixed-io.eds (0x6000:1 (8 bit), 0x6000:2 (8 bit)); a PDO with the device mapping can only use these objects

cases.name: fixed COB-ID set to another value
messages: node 2 (pingpong): TPDO 1: 'cob_id' needs object 0x1800 subindex 1, but its AccessType in fixed-io.eds is ro (EDS value 0x182, config 0x190); leave the field out or set it to the EDS value

cases.name: fixed COB-ID off the CiA 301 default
messages: node 2 (pingpong): TPDO 2: fixed-io.eds fixes the COB-ID at 0x382 (0x1801 subindex 1 is ro), but the plugin uses the CiA 301 default 0x282; set 'cob_id' to the EDS value

cases.name: fixed COB-ID off the default, set in the config
device mapping without a default in the EDS
messages: node 2 (pingpong): TPDO 1 uses the device mapping, but fixed-io-no-default.eds gives no default mapping (0x1A00 subindex 1 has no DefaultValue, or 0)

cases.name: device mapping chosen on a writable PDO
device mapping with the wrong type

cases.name: unknown mapping mode
plugin_messages: field 'mapping' must be "config" or "device", not "auto"

cases.name: diagnostics with the former token_sha256
plugin_messages: master.diagnostics.token_sha256: the diagnostics channel is encrypted now

cases.name: diagnostics token verifier malformed
plugin_messages: master.diagnostics: field 'token_verifier' must look like SCRAM-SHA-256$

cases.name: diagnostics port below 1024
plugin_messages: master.diagnostics: field 'port' must be 1024-65535

cases.name: diagnostics bind not an IPv4 address
plugin_messages: master.diagnostics: field 'bind' must be an IPv4 address

cases.name: empty node list without diagnostics

cases.name: eds_lint unknown value

cases.name: eds_lint and strict_eds
messages: master: give either 'eds_lint' or the deprecated 'strict_eds', not both

cases.name: blocking lint finding with eds_lint off
warnings: EDS lint/comm-broken.eds: 1 lint finding accepted (eds_lint "off"): 0x1A00 sub 0

cases.name: limit-only lint findings accepted
warnings: EDS lint/signed-hex.eds: 2 lint findings accepted (not in the communication objects, or only about limits): 0x6061: HighLimit overflow in [6061]

cases.name: strict_eds true with a finding in 0x6061
messages: EDS lint/signed-hex.eds fails dcfgen's lint (eds_lint "all"): 0x6061: HighLimit overflow in [6061]

cases.name: LSS assignment with an EDS without LSS_Supported
warnings: node 2 (pingpong): its EDS does not say LSS_Supported=1; LSS assignment may not work with this device

cases.name: LSS assignment without a serial number
messages: node 2 (pingpong): LSS assignment ('lss.assign') needs 'serial_number'

cases.name: LSS store without assign
messages: node 2 (pingpong): 'lss.store' needs 'lss.assign'

cases.name: LSS assignment without communication reset
messages: node 2 (pingpong): 'lss.assign' needs 'reset_communication' true: a node ID set by LSS becomes active only on a communication reset

cases.name: LSS assign not a boolean
plugin_messages: field 'assign' must be true or false

cases.name: two nodes with the same LSS address
messages: node 2 (pingpong) and node 3 (twin) have the same LSS address (vendor ID 0x00000360, product code 0x00000000, serial number 0x00001234)

cases.name: two LSS nodes with different revisions
CiA 402 axis not an object
plugin_messages: field 'axis' must be an object

cases.name: CiA 402 axis scale_denominator 0
plugin_messages: field 'scale_denominator' must be between 1 and

cases.name: CiA 402 axis scale_factor 0
plugin_messages: field 'scale_factor' must not be 0

cases.name: CiA 402 axis scale_numerator 0
plugin_messages: field 'scale_numerator' must not be 0
tool_messages: nodes[0].axis.scale_numerator: scale numerator must not be 0

cases.name: CiA 402 axis scale_numerator not an integer
plugin_messages: field 'scale_numerator' must be an integer

cases.name: automatic receive timeout from the event timer
automatic receive timeout without an event timer
messages: node 2 (pingpong): TPDO 1: 'timeout_ms' "auto" needs the PDO's event timer, but its EDS value is 0; give the timeout in milliseconds instead

cases.name: receive timeout on an RPDO
messages: RPDO 1: field 'timeout_ms' is only for tx_pdos (PDOs the node sends)

cases.name: receive timeout of 0
messages: TPDO 1: field 'timeout_ms' must be 1-65535 or "auto"; leave it out for no timeout

cases.name: timeout bit without a receive timeout
messages: TPDO 1: field 'timeout_location' needs 'timeout_ms'

cases.name: on_timeout not hold or zero
messages: TPDO 1: field 'on_timeout' must be "hold" or "zero", not "last"

cases.name: timeout bit not a bit
messages: TPDO 1: field 'timeout_location' must be an input bit (%IX...), not %IB10

cases.name: TPDO above 4 without cob_id
messages: TPDO 5 has no default COB-ID; set 'cob_id' (or "auto")
